🌟 scottokeebs | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing open-source designs and resources for hobbyists to build their own custom handwired mechanical keyboards and macropads.
✨ Key Features: • Free-to-build handwired keyboard and macropad projects • Over 19 released projects • Projects designed for common 220x220mm 3D printers • Minimal support material required for 3D prints
📖 Summary: This repository offers a comprehensive collection of free, open-source designs for building custom handwired mechanical keyboards and macropads. It provides detailed project files and guidance, enabling users to create their own unique input devices using common microcontrollers like Arduino Pro Micro or Raspberry Pi Pico.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 lipflow | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a silent, hands-free method of text input by transcribing lip movements captured via a webcam, useful for situations where voice input is not feasible or desired.
✨ Key Features: • Webcam-based lip reading for silent text transcription • Runs locally on Mac, Windows, and Linux • Optional LLM cleanup for enhanced accuracy • Personalized language model training using user dictation history • Customizable push-to-talk key and hands-free modes
📖 Summary: Lipflow is a local application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that transcribes silent lip movements captured by a webcam into text, which is then pasted at the cursor. It offers optional LLM-based cleanup for improved accuracy and customizes its language model based on user dictation history and practice.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 logo-design-skill | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: To empower AI agents to perform disciplined identity design and create professional logo assets.
✨ Key Features: • Covers logo design principles and process from brief to delivery. • Includes a searchable library of 1,400+ SVG logos classified by various attributes. • Provides dependency-free Python tools for auditing SVGs, creating test sheets, client presentation boards, and exporting icon sets.
📖 Summary: This repository provides a comprehensive logo design skill for AI agents like Claude, Gemini CLI, and Codex. It guides users through the entire logo design process, from initial brief to production-ready SVG files and brand guidelines, incorporating design principles and a large reference library.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ openDAW | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an accessible, free, and privacy-focused web-based platform for music production and education.
✨ Key Features: • Web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) • Democratizes music production • High-quality creation tools • Focus on education • Strong data-privacy (no sign-up, tracking, profiling, ads, etc.)
📖 Summary: openDAW is a next-generation, web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) focused on democratizing music production through accessible, high-quality creation tools. It prioritizes education and data privacy with a commitment to transparency, offering a completely free and open-source experience without sign-ups, tracking, or ads.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 Hunyuan3D-2-WinPortable | Batchfile
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an easy-to-install and run portable application for generating 3D models and textures using Hunyuan3D on Windows, optimized for users with consumer-grade NVIDIA GPUs.
✨ Key Features: • Portable package for Hunyuan3D 2.0/2.1 on Windows • Optimized for consumer-grade GPUs (via mmgp integration) • Support for specific CUDA versions (12.6 and 12.9) • Clear instructions for setup and requirements • Optional Developer Mode for efficient model storage
📖 Summary: This repository provides a portable package for running Hunyuan3D 2.0 and 2.1 on Windows. It integrates optimizations for consumer-grade GPUs and offers versions compatible with specific CUDA toolkits, simplifying the setup for 3D generation tasks.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
